title: GPT image 2.0で「奥にヒーローを配置」したキーフレーム画像を作り、それをSeedance 2.5に渡して縮尺と光線方向を固定する
content:
GPT image 2.0で「奥にヒーローを配置」したキーフレーム画像を作り、それをSeedance 2.5に渡して縮尺と光線方向を固定する  
複雑な構図はプロンプトだけで詰めず、参照素材（キーフレーム/画像）を用意してSeedanceに渡して迷子を防ぐ

en.content:
Create a keyframe image in GPT Image 2.0 with the “hero placed in the background,” then pass it to Seedance 2.5 to lock in the scale and direction of the light rays.  
For complex compositions, don’t try to force everything through the prompt alone—prepare reference materials (keyframes/images) and pass them to Seedance to keep it from getting lost.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Until I showed it this far, no matter how many prompts I entered, it kept getting lost.

Reference materials are really important.

Here is the registration link for Sousaku AI. https://t.co/fdC2KIlaIi https://t.co/GW4crhzYnC
